source.title: Functional organization of the hippocampal longitudinal axis.

confidence_rationale: Authoritative review directly addressing the source thought's candidate biological prediction 4 (longitudinal differences correspond to different levels of granularity) and bearing on prediction 1 (subregions preferentially encode different relation types). It supports the weaker organisational reading -- multiple functional domains plus superimposed gradients -- but says nothing about higher-order or multistep relational structure, which is Q-084's actual proposition. Filed at 0.60 because the mapping is to the thought's background hypothesis rather than to the registered claim.
failure_signatures: The long axis shows BOTH sharply demarcated gene-expression domains AND continuous anatomical/electrophysiological gradients, so a clean 'one subregion, one relation type' partition is not what the biology offers -- an REE design that assigns distinct relation types to distinct discrete modules would be over-committing.

Multiple functional organisations along the axis are established at the level of granularity and affective-versus-spatial function, not at the level of RELATION TYPE, so the review does not deliver the differentiated-relational-organisation evidence the source thought hoped for.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The hippocampal long axis is not simply dichotomous (dorsal-spatial/memory versus ventral-anxiety); gene expression reveals multiple functional domains with sharply demarcated borders, while anatomy and electrophysiology reveal continuous gradients, supporting a model in which long-axis gradients are superimposed on discrete functional domains.
mapping.ree_translation: The Q-084 source thought's candidate biological prediction 4 was that longitudinal hippocampal differences correspond to different levels of spatial, temporal, contextual or abstract granularity, and prediction 1 that different subregions preferentially encode different relation types. This review substantiates the granularity/multiple-organisation reading at the coarse level: the hippocampus is not running one uniform relational computation. For REE it supports keeping scale-tagged anchors and multiple coexisting organisational levels rather than collapsing to a single adjacency, which is MECH-469's territory more than Q-084's.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is the weakest-mapped entry in the folder and is filed as background rather than as evidence on the registered proposition. Q-084 is specifically about structure ABOVE a pairwise relation -- metapaths, hyperedges, simplicial relations -- and the long-axis literature is about anatomical and functional differentiation, which is an orthogonal axis of variation. Multiple organisations existing does not entail that any of them is higher-order. The domains distinguished are granularity and affective-versus-spatial function, not relation type, so even the source thought's prediction 1 is only indirectly addressed. Rodent and human anatomy, gene expression and ephys; no agent-architecture mapping is direct.
mapping.source_context: Rodent and human hippocampus; review of gene-expression, anatomical tract-tracing, and electrophysiological evidence on dorsoventral/anteroposterior organisation.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality very high (NRN review, authors include Witter and Moser). Mapping fidelity is deliberately low and dominates the aggregate: the paper addresses the source thought's background hypothesis about multiple relational organisations, not Q-084's higher-order proposition. Recorded at 0.60 to avoid inflating Q-084's literature confidence with adjacent-but-not-on-point evidence.
